name: Li Andersson-Commission proposal
title: Guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the European Union's yearly guidelines for national employment policies. It approves the Commission's proposal but wants it changed. It asks for stronger protection of workers: fair pay, safe workplaces, rights to training and to switch off from work, and action against discrimination and poverty. It also wants social partners more involved and more support for young people, older workers, people with disabilities and those fleeing Ukraine. This is an opinion only; the Council decides.

- The text adds calls for fair pay, decent conditions, training rights and help for disadvantaged groups.
- It affects workers, jobseekers, young people, older people and people with disabilities across the EU.
- The Council now considers Parliament's amendments before deciding.
